name: code-review
title_zh: 按仓库自己的规范和原始 issue 双线审你的改动
tagline_zh: 改完一坨代码，最怕没人指出你漏了 issue 里的需求、又踩了仓库没写进 README 的规矩。
tagline_en: Two parallel sub-agents review your diff from a fixed base: one checks the repo's documented standards, one.
desc_en: Review the changes since a fixed point (commit, branch, tag, or merge-base) along two axes: Standards (does the code follow this repo's documented coding standards?) and Spec (does the code match what the originating issue/spec asked for?). Runs both reviews in parallel sub-agents and reports them side by side. Use when the user wants to review a branch, a PR, work-in-progress changes, or asks to
why_zh: 规范和 spec 分开审，不混成一句「代码不错」。基点由你指定，commit、branch。
why_en: Standards and spec are reviewed separately, never blurred into one vague verdict. You pick the base: commit, branch, tag, or.
limit_zh: 仓库得真有成文规范可读，没有的话 Standards 那条只能靠通用直觉。
limit_en: Needs documented repo standards and the original issue text; without them it falls back to generic judgment. Report only, no code changes.
